settings.headline:
Stories that
outlast the credits.
settings.copy: Northlight Pictures is an independent studio crafting character-driven features and documentaries. From the first draft to the final cut, we keep the whole process under one roof — so the story never gets lost in the machine.

trust_list.text: A studio, not a service — we develop our own slate

settings.title: A slate we're
settings.intro: We make the films we'd want to see — quiet, precise, and unafraid of a hard question. Here's a look at what's come out of the studio.

features.title: The Long Winter
features.text: A lighthouse keeper's daughter returns to the island she fled, only to find the storm she left behind was never the weather. Our most awarded feature to date.

features.title: Salt & Cedar
features.text: Two brothers inherit a failing boatyard and a debt neither can name. A quiet study of inheritance, pride, and the cost of holding on.

features.title: The Cartographer's Wife
features.text: A documentary following a woman who has spent thirty years mapping the last unmapped coastline in the world — and what she's leaving behind.

features.title: Low Tide
features.text: A coming-of-age story set over one summer on a shrinking fishing town, where a teenage diver finds more than he was looking for.

features.title: The Glasshouse
features.text: A botanist and a thief collide in a derelict Victorian conservatory. A two-hander about trust, told almost entirely in one room.

features.title: North of Nowhere
features.text: Our debut — a road film about a father and daughter driving the length of a country neither of them calls home anymore.

settings.title: From first draft to

steps.title: Develop
steps.text: It starts with a script we believe in. We develop our own slate in-house, working the story until it's ready to stand on its own.

steps.title: Finance & plan
steps.text: We build a realistic budget and schedule, then bring in partners who care about the film as much as the return.

steps.title: Produce
steps.text: Small, trusted crews. We shoot with intention — every scene earns its place, every day is planned to protect the story.

steps.title: Post & release
steps.text: Editing, sound, and grade in our own suite. Then we take the film to festivals, distributors, and the audiences it was made for.

settings.note: Most features move from greenlight to festival premiere in 18–24 months. We keep the team small so the vision stays intact from page to screen.

settings.title: Nine filmmakers,
settings.intro: No freelancers, no revolving door. Everyone you meet is a full-time part of the studio, and every film carries all of our names.

members.name: Elena Marsh
members.bio: Directed five of our features. Believes a film is finished when it's honest, not when it's safe.

members.name: Tom Okafor
members.bio: Keeps the schedules honest and the budgets real. Has never missed a call time in fourteen years.

members.name: Ruth Lindqvist
members.bio: Wrote The Long Winter and Salt & Cedar. A former journalist who still chases the truth in every draft.

members.name: Marco Delgado
members.bio: Shoots on film whenever the budget allows. Obsessed with light, shadow, and the space between actors.

members.name: Aisha Rahman
members.bio: The final cut is hers. Known for finding the film in the footage everyone else thought was unusable.

members.name: Jonas Weber
members.bio: Builds the worlds you hear. Every room, every silence, every breath is placed with intent.

settings.title: Have a story?
settings.intro: Whether you're a writer with a script, a partner with a project, or a festival looking to screen our work — we'd love to hear from you.

settings.blurb: An independent film studio crafting character-driven features and documentaries — from first draft to final cut, under one roof.
